definitions.full: H8164. sair שְׂעִירִים noun [masculine] plural rain (-drops), si vera lectio; (so according to Vrss and context; Thes compare II. שַׂעַר ; Lag proposes רְסִיסִים ); — ׳כִּשׂ עֲלֵידֶֿשֶׁא Deut 32:2 (|| רְבִיבִים טַל, מָטָר, ).
